cohort: The study included preterm babies delivered and admitted to Bingham University Teaching Hospital's inborn Special Care Baby Unit between January 2021 and June 2022.
finding: Preterm premature membrane rupture and preeclampsia were the most frequent risk factors for prematurity, while jaundice and anaemia were prevalent morbidities, and the overall mortality rate was 20%.
followup_time: up to 182 days (duration of hospital stay)
